description: This Java class, ShoppingListEvents, manages shopping list operations such as adding items from a shopping cart to lists, creating auto-save lists, saving/restoring shopping cart contents, and handling related shopping list data. It interacts with the data layer via OFBiz entities and performs service calls to support shopping list functionality within the application.

classes.name: ShoppingListEvents
classes.description: This class contains static methods for managing shopping lists and shopping cart interactions, including adding items, creating auto-save lists, saving/restoring carts, and handling guest cookies.

methods.name: addBulkFromCart
methods.description: Adds multiple items from the shopping cart to a specified shopping list, creating the list if necessary.

methods.name: addBulkFromCart
methods.description: Internal method that handles the logic of adding multiple cart items to a shopping list, including list creation, validation, and item transfer.

methods.name: addListToCart
methods.description: Adds all items from a specified shopping list into the shopping cart.

methods.name: addListToCart
methods.description: Internal method that performs the logic of retrieving shopping list items and adding them to the cart, with options for appending or replacing.

methods.name: replaceShoppingListItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific shopping list item.

methods.name: getAutoSaveListId
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an auto-save shopping list ID for the user.

methods.name: fillAutoSaveList
methods.description: Populates the auto-save shopping list with the current shopping cart contents.

methods.name: saveCartToAutoSaveList
methods.description: Saves the current cart contents to the auto-save list.

methods.name: restoreAutoSaveList
methods.description: Restores items from the auto-save list into the shopping cart, with checks for last modification times.

methods.name: clearListInfo
methods.description: Removes all items and survey responses associated with a specified shopping list.

methods.name: makeListItemSurveyResp
methods.description: Creates survey response records for a shopping list item.

methods.name: getItemAttributeInfos
methods.description: Returns a map of item sequence IDs to their attributes.

methods.name: getItemSurveyInfos
methods.description: Returns a map of item sequence IDs to their survey responses.

methods.name: getItemSurveyInfo
methods.description: Returns a list of survey response IDs for a specific shopping list item.

methods.name: createGuestShoppingListCookies
methods.description: Creates cookies for guest users to store a shopping list ID.

methods.name: clearGuestShoppingListCookies
methods.description: Clears the guest shopping list cookies.
